# commander_classic_server (Resource)

Creates and manages a Keeper **server credentials** record (`serverCredentials`) in the vault.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commander_classic_server" "example" {
  title = "Test Server Record Type"

  login    = "root"
  password = "ExamplePassword123!"
  hostname = "localhost"
  port     = "22"

  notes           = "test notes"
  folder_location = "_REPLACE_WITH_FOLDER_PATH_OR_UID_"

  share = {
    "alice@example.com" = {
      can_share = true
      can_edit  = true
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Record title.

### Optional

- `custom` (Attributes List) Manage custom fields for the record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom))
- `folder_location` (String) Folder `path` or `UID` where the record is to be stored.
- `hostname` (String) Server host name or IP address. Maps to `host.hostName` in the record's `host` field.
- `login` (String) Server login or username. Maps to the record's `login` field.
- `notes` (String) Manage note for the record.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Server password. Maps to the record's `password` field.
- `port` (String) Server port. Maps to `host.port` in the record's `host` field.
- `share` (Attributes Map) Mapping of share permissions for this record. Each map **key** is a **user email**; each **value** is an object with `can_share` and `can_edit` booleans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UID) of the vault record.

<a id="nestedatt--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Required:

- `label` (String) Field label.
- `type` (String) Keeper field type (e.g. `text`, `email`, `secret`, `phone`, `name`, `date`).
- `value` (String) Field value; for complex types use `jsonencode(JSON)` matching the [Keeper field schema](https://docs.keeper.io/en/keeperpam/secrets-manager/about/field-record-types).

Optional:

- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether to mark the value as sensitive in Terraform state display.


<a id="nestedatt--share"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share`

Optional:

- `can_edit` (Boolean) Allow the user to edit this record. Defaults to `false`.
- `can_share` (Boolean) Allow the user to re-share this record with other users. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import is supported. The import ID is the vault record UID of the serverCredentials record.

terraform import commander_classic_server.imported_server "OjgmY-sRsNmu3tVFY7F4_A"
```
